franchisee.s: ...National Restaurants, a New York franchisee for Pizza Hut.

allowed.s: Whoever says that is not allowed.

costing.t: 成本计算；生产费用；花费（cost的ing形式）
costing.e: the process of calculating the cost of a future business activity, product etc, or the calculation itself；When something that you plan to do or make is costed, the amount of money you need is calculated in advance
costing.s: the planning and costing of staffing levels

overtrade.e: (of an enterprise) to trade in excess of capacity or working capital

drawee.t: （支票、汇票等的）付款人；[贸易] 受票人
drawee.e: the person or organization on which a cheque or other order for payment is drawn
drawee.s: B;Of course ,we must give these checks to drawee bank to collect the funds they owe us .

appraiser.s: Judicial expertise institution and judicial appraiser should be neutral.

telesales.e: a way of selling products to people by telephone
telesales.s: Many people start their careers in telesales.

gearing.t: 传动装置；以齿轮连起；配搭活动（gear的ing形式）
gearing.e: an assembly of gears designed to transmit motion
gearing.s: The gearing of this machine is unusual.

jackpot.t: 头奖；累积赌注；十分成功；头奖的；累积赌注的；大笔收入的
jackpot.e: a large amount of money that you can win in a game that is decided by chance

arbitrage.e: the process of buying something such as raw materials or  currency  in one place and selling them immediately in another place in order to make a profit from the difference in prices
arbitrage.s: Astute Singaporeans quickly spotted an arbitrage opportunity.

sourcing.t: [电子] 纯源化；发起；向…提供消息（source的ing形式）
sourcing.e: The source of something is the person, place, or thing which you get it from
sourcing.s: ...over 40 percent of adults use television as their major source of information about the arts.

reposition.t: 使复位；改变…的位置；使变换阵地；复位；贮藏；放回
reposition.s: It is not possible to reposition the rug without damaging it.

privatize.e: if a government privatizes an organization, industry, or service that it owns or controls, it sells it

launder.t: 洗涤；清洗；洗黑钱（把来路可疑的钱弄得貌似合法）；流水槽
launder.e: to wash and iron clothes, sheets etc
launder.s: He was jailed of laundering drug money.

papers.e: Your papers are official documents, such as your passport or identity card, that prove who you are or that give you official permission to do something
papers.s: A young Moroccan stopped by police refused to show his papers.

bearish.e: a bearish market is one where the prices of  share s  are decreasing
bearish.s: It is foolish not to invest in stocks, so I will show her how to be bearish without them too, if she chooses.

leasehold.e: leasehold property is property that you will own only for the period of time stated in a lease
leasehold.s: The sale of residential property was not allowed until the late 1980s, and even then under a leasehold system that gives buyers 70 years of ownership.

finances.s: A United States delegation is in Japan seeking finance for a major scientific project.

kickback.t: 回扣；佣金；强烈反应；退回赃物
kickback.e: money that some­one pays secretly and dishonestly in return for someone’s help

watered.t: 掺水的；洒有水的；洒了水的；有波纹的；加虚股的（面值增加而实值未按比例增加）；浇水
watered.e: If you water plants, you pour water over them in order to help them to grow
watered.s: He went out to water the plants.

newsagent.e: someone who owns or works in a shop that sells newspapers, magazines, sweets and cigarettes

securities.t: [金融] 有价证券；担保；抵押物（security的复数）；保证人
securities.e: If something is security for a loan, you promise to give that thing to the person who lends you money, if you fail to pay the money back
securities.s: The central bank will provide special loans, and the banks will pledge the land as security.

debenture.t: （英）[金融] 公司债券；[税收] 退税证明书
debenture.e: an official document produced by a company showing how much  interest  it will pay on a  loan

debtee.s: Accounting information is the evidence of economic decision between the nation, investors and debtee.

skimming.t: 撇取浮沫；浮渣；撇去…的浮物（skim的ing形式）
skimming.e: If you skim something from the surface of a liquid, you remove it
skimming.s: Rough seas today prevented specially equipped ships from skimming oil off the water's surface.

rework.e: If you rework something such as an idea or a piece of writing, you reorganize it and make changes to it in order to improve it or bring it up to date
rework.s: See if you can rework your schedule and come up with practical ways to reduce the number of hours you're on call.

futures.t: 期货；未来；前途（future的复数形式）
futures.e: The future is the period of time that will come after the present, or the things that will happen then
futures.s: The spokesman said no decision on the proposal was likely in the immediate future.

autarky.e: (esp of a political unit) a system or policy of economic self-sufficiency aimed at removing the need for imports
autarky.s: Were Indians “mindlessly aping” Western lifestyles more or less when India had its idiotic policy of autarky?

slowdown.e: a reduction in activity or speed
slowdown.s: There has been a sharp slowdown in economic growth.

tiptop.t: 最高点；绝顶；黄金时代；极好的；第一流的；非常好地
tiptop.e: You can use tiptop to indicate that something is extremely good
tiptop.s: Her hair was thick, glossy and in tiptop condition.

arbitration.e: the process of judging officially how an argument should be settled
arbitration.s: The dispute is going to arbitration (=  someone is being asked to arbitrate  ) .

punctuality.e: Punctuality is the quality of being punctual
punctuality.s: The airline hopes to improve punctuality next year.

strategize.s: Which: Identify your obstacles and strategize to overcome them.

financing.t: 融资；财务；筹措资金；财政管理；从事金融活动（finance的ing形式）
financing.e: Finance is also a noun；When someone finances something such as a project or a purchase, they provide the money that is needed to pay for them
financing.s: A United States delegation is in Japan seeking finance for a major scientific project.

going.t: 行为；离去；工作情况；地面状况；流行的；进行中的
going.e: the act of leaving a place；The going rate or the going salary is the usual amount of money that you expect to pay or receive for something
going.s: His going will be no great loss to the company.

devaluation.s: Nothing like that has happened in Europe — yet. But it’s certainly within the realm of possibility, especially as the pain of austerity and internal devaluation drags on.

floatation.s: The water sports centre will provide you with snorkelling gear and a floatation vest if you would like one.

entitlement.e: the official right to have or do something, or the amount that you have a right to receive
entitlement.s: They lose their entitlement to welfare when they start work.

arbitrageur.t: 从事于套利或套汇之人

extractive.t: 提取物；抽出物；精华；提取的；可萃取的；精萃的
extractive.e: something extracted or capable of being extracted；tending or serving to extract

showroom.e: a large room where you can look at things that are for sale, such as cars or electrical goods

capitalization.s: The world's artwork market capitalization is overwhelming tide and trend.

counting.s: You must be accurate in counting.

prescriptive.e: saying how something should or must be done, or what should be done

collectable.e: something that is collectable is likely to be bought and kept as part of a group of similar things, especially because it might increase in value
collectable.s: They often come up for sale, but this more intimate and later artwork is quite rare and very collectable.

provider.e: a company or person that provides a service

fixable.t: 可固定的；可确定的；可装置的

addressee.t: 收件人；收信人；[计] 被访地址
addressee.e: the person a letter, package etc is addressed to

adjuster.t: [自] 调节器；调停者；（保险等）理算员
adjuster.e: An adjuster is a device that allows you to alter a piece of equipment's position or setting

collectivism.e: a political system in which all businesses, farms etc are owned by the government
collectivism.s: Toohey is the exception: he is the one character in Rand's work who fully comprehends the difference between good and evil, between individualism and collectivism, and consciously chooses evil.

stakeholder.t: 利益相关者；赌金保管者
stakeholder.e: someone chosen to hold the money that is risked by people on a race, competition etc and to give all of it to the winner
stakeholder.s: ...the Delaware River Port Authority, a major stakeholder in Penn's Landing.

synergy.e: the additional effectiveness when two or more companies or people combine and work together
synergy.s: Of course, there's quite obviously a lot of synergy between the two companies.

fiduciary.t: 信托的；受信托的；基于信用的；受托人；被信托者
fiduciary.e: Fiduciary is used to talk about things which relate to a trust, or to the people who are in charge of a trust
fiduciary.s: They have a case against their directors for breach of fiduciary duty.

guidebook.e: a book about a city, country etc

teahouse.e: a special house in China or Japan where tea is served, often as part of a ceremony
teahouse.s: Another dust-up took place in the teahouse.

sights.e: A sight is something that you see
sights.s: The practice of hanging clothes across the street is a common sight in many parts of the city.

helpline.e: a telephone number that you can ring if you need advice or information
helpline.s: ...Greece's first helpline for gamblers who need counselling.

communications.e: Communications are the systems and processes that are used to communicate or broadcast information, especially by means of electricity or radio waves

hurdles.e: Hurdles is a race in which people have to jump over a number of obstacles that are also called hurdles. You can use hurdles to refer to one or more races.
hurdles.s: Davis won the 400 metre hurdles in a new Olympic time of 49.3 sec.

sportsperson.e: someone who takes part in sports or a sport
sportsperson.s: An Australian researcher has found your chances of becoming a professional sportsperson could depend on your birthday.

instructions.s: The next instructions will add these for the service.

riding.e: the sport or activity of riding horses

congratulations.e: If you offer someone your congratulations, you congratulate them on something nice that has happened to them or on something good that they have done
congratulations.s: The club also offers its congratulations to D. Brown on her appointment as president.

recycling.e: the process of treating used objects or materials so that they can be used again
recycling.s: Recycling is important to help protect our environment.

cheeseburger.e: a  hamburger  cooked with a piece of cheese on top of the meat
cheeseburger.s: I'd like a cheeseburger to take away, please.

bedside.e: the area beside your bed – used especially when talking about someone who is ill in bed
bedside.s: She put a cup of tea down on the bedside table.

façade.s: The volume and the façade are the only territories of design freedom, along with some decisions with respect to finishes in the lobbies and the parking areas.

resumé.s: What do you do after being a spy? Do you sell insurance? And how do you get a new career when your resumé is blank?
